name: shellink
description: One stable CLI and daemon for SSH, local PTY sessions, file transfer, and remote editing — built for AI agents and humans alike.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web & wait
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build --workspace=web && node scripts/embed-web.mjs && npm run build --workspace=protocol && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=cli
scripts.build:binary:current: npm run build:runtime && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --outfile=dist/shellink cli/dist/index.js
scripts.build:binary:macos-arm64: npm run build:runtime && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=dist/shellink-darwin-arm64 cli/dist/index.js
scripts.build:binary:macos-x64: npm run build:runtime && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile=dist/shellink-darwin-x64 cli/dist/index.js
scripts.build:binary:linux-arm64: npm run build:runtime && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=dist/shellink-linux-arm64 cli/dist/index.js
scripts.build:binary:linux-x64: npm run build:runtime && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=dist/shellink-linux-x64 cli/dist/index.js
scripts.build:binary:all: npm run build:runtime && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile=dist/shellink-darwin-arm64 cli/dist/index.js && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile=dist/shellink-darwin-x64 cli/dist/index.js && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile=dist/shellink-linux-arm64 cli/dist/index.js && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --compile-autoload-package-json --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile=dist/shellink-linux-x64 cli/dist/index.js
